extraction.Name: Edward Beauvais
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 22, 1921 by the Todd County State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Beauvais conveyed the land by deed to James S. Slaughter for $2300.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739629 issued; Northeast quarter of section 10, township 39, range 28; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; conveyance to James S. Slaughter dated September 6, 1924
